spec: Standalone game Genome. Constructor takes the DNA token address (balanceOf only) and threshold 1_000_000e18. claimGenome(): caller with balance >= threshold and no genome gets one: seed = keccak(sender, blockhash(-1)), no traits, mutations 0, scars 0. mutate(): once per 24h per genome; if balance >= threshold, mutations++ and a trait byte keccak(seed, mutations, blockhash(-1)) is appended (max 32); else scars++ (max 255). Per-address, non-transferable; no mint, no approvals, no ETH, no payable, no power over hook or fees. Views: genomeOf(address) -> seed, traits, mutations, scars, lastAct; svg(address) -> SVG drawn from traits with a mark per scar. Safe-only pause stops claim and mutate. Page: wallet connect, claim/mutate buttons, render SVG. Tests: threshold, double claim, cooldown, scars, pause, gas. (a game build)
